entities.summary: Daniel Palmer is an English guitarist. He was born in Sheffield, South Yorkshire, England, and now lives in Whittier, California, United States. He is the lead guitarist of the bands Death By Stereo and Zebrahead. Palmer is a longtime user of Fernandes Guitars. Dan Palmer was a composers & musicians from England (b. 1978-08-14, England). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
